claims.statement: This source page is gated by workflow-execution-protections: its pinned feature definition includes fpt/ghec and GHES >=3.23. Redirects are navigation metadata; they do not establish availability on older GHES versions.

Actions policies are configured under Policies, separately from General settings, at repository, organization or enterprise level. The source currently describes workflow execution protections only; planned future policies are not implemented evidence.

Workflow execution protections can allowlist actors and permitted events, restricting pull_request_target, manual dispatch and low-trust actors and overriding misconfigured workflow files. These are described capabilities, not proof that this estate enables them.
When protections are enforced, disallowed workflow runs fail with an error. The workflow_dispatch error is an illustrative example, not an observed negative test.

The conditional default-pull-req-target-policy reusable states a default public-repository pull_request_target block will be enforced on November 2, 2026. The source expiry comment and fpt/ghec feature gate are retained; this future source assertion does not establish present enforcement.

Actor rules cover individual users, repository roles, GitHub Apps, Copilot and Dependabot. The described default allows users with write access to trigger workflows; explicit actor rules can separate code contribution from workflow execution.
Event rules govern allowed events, including push, pull_request, pull_request_target and workflow_dispatch. Planned additional rules remain future intent.
Configuration and REST policy links are references for next steps; their linked bodies were not reviewed or executed in this five-file pilot.
